revelation.19.p1.b1.text: After this I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude in heaven, shouting:

revelation.19.p1.b2.text: “Hallelujah! Salvation and glory and power belong to our God!

revelation.19.p1.b3.text: For His judgments are true and just. He has judged the great prostitute who corrupted the earth with her immorality. He has avenged the blood of His servants that was poured out by her hand.”

revelation.19.p1.b4.text: And a second time they called out: “Hallelujah! Her smoke rises forever and ever.”

revelation.19.p2.b1.text: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying:

revelation.19.p2.b3.text: Then a voice came from the throne, saying: “Praise our God, all you who serve Him, and those who fear Him, small and great alike!”

revelation.19.p3.b1.text: And I heard a sound like the roar of a great multitude, like the rushing of many waters, and like a mighty rumbling of thunder, crying out:

revelation.19.p3.b2.text: “Hallelujah! For the Lord our God the Almighty reigns.

revelation.19.p3.b3.text: Let us rejoice and be glad and give Him the glory. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready.

revelation.19.p3.b4.text: She was given clothing of fine linen, bright and pure.” For the fine linen she wears is the righteous acts of the saints.

revelation.19.p4.b1.text: Then the angel told me to write, “Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.” … “These are the true words of God.”

revelation.19.p4.b2.text: So I fell at his feet to worship him.

revelation.19.p4.b4.text: I am a fellow servant with you and your brothers who rely on the testimony of Jesus. Worship God!

revelation.19.p5.b1.text: Then I saw heaven standing open, and there before me was a white horse. And its rider is called Faithful and True. With righteousness He judges and wages war.

revelation.19.p5.b2.text: He has eyes like blazing fire, and many royal crowns on His head. He has a name written on Him that only He Himself knows.

revelation.19.p5.b3.text: He is dressed in a robe dipped in blood, and His name is The Word of God.

revelation.19.p6.b1.text: The armies of heaven, dressed in fine linen, white and pure, follow Him on white horses.

revelation.19.p6.b2.text: And from His mouth proceeds a sharp sword with which to strike down the nations, and He will rule them with an iron scepter. He treads the winepress of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.

revelation.19.p6.b3.text: And He has a name written on His robe and on His thigh: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS.
